author: Binay Verma
status: Registered before any parameter selection or forecast for these states; no outcome of these states has been evaluated in this project.

hypotheses.H1: SARIMAX(1,0,0)(1,0,0,7): typed-day minus pooled-day event MASE at lead 1 is NEGATIVE (typed better).
hypotheses.H2: TimesFM-3 (pinned weights): typed-day minus pooled-day event MASE at lead 1 is POSITIVE (pooled better).
hypotheses.H3: LightGBM with minimum leaf size fixed at 2 (parameters otherwise from the pre-year selection): typed-day minus pooled-day event MASE at lead 1 is POSITIVE (pooled better).

reported_not_tested: zero and placebo controls (local models only; foundation runs use calendar, typed-day and pooled-day arms)
test: Per state, family and year: mean lead-1 MASE over the event cases, typed-day minus pooled-day. Cluster = family-year; cluster value = equal-weight mean over the states in that cluster. Statistic = mean over clusters. One-sided sign-flip p in the hypothesised direction, Monte Carlo with 1,000,000 sign draws (numpy default_rng seed 20261113), p = (k+1)/(N+1). Holm across H1-H3, alpha 0.05.
decision: CONFIRMED if the Holm-adjusted p < 0.05 AND the year means (each year = mean of its family-year clusters) have the hypothesised sign in at least 6 of the 9 event years. CONTRADICTED if the overall mean has the opposite sign and its opposite-direction one-sided p < 0.05 (not Holm-adjusted). Otherwise NOT CONFIRMED.
sensitivity: Pre-declared, reported alongside without changing the decision: (a) 2020-2021 removed (COVID); (b) only rows with an official or government-reproduction source.
conventions: anchors = state-listed festival days as checked (review/new_states_v1/DESIGN_DRAFT.md conventions 1-6)
weekend festivals stay flagged; optional-only years get no flag
case rule, frames, placebos (seed 42), regression and SARIMAX code as Stage A
cases whose label is missing or non-positive are dropped before registration
